d:
The Nets defeated the Pelicans, 145-111 tonight in New Orleans. Michael Porter Jr. contributed a team-high 22 points to go with 6 rebounds 4 three pointers and 3 assists, with Egor Dëmin of the Nets adding an additional 22 points (5-8 FG, 4-6 3P) in the game. Zion Williamson finished with a team-high 29 points along with 4 rebounds for the Pelicans in the losing effort. The Nets improve their record to 3-8 with the win, while the Pelicans fall to 4-8 for the season.
